traits.name: Fence's Eye
traits.text: Fences live by their ability to recognize a viable trade. They can use Underworld Lore to identify an item's value and Identify Magic on an item. They gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Underworld Lore checks when doing so, and to Underworld Lore checks to determine whether an item was stolen, whether a stolen item would be too recognizable to easily move, and who would be interested in purchasing such an item.

traits.name: Items
traits.text: dagger (10), lesser darkvision elixir, disguise kit, bird feather token, lesser smokestick (2), shortsword, thieves' tools;

traits.name: Quick Rummage
traits.text: ⬻ The fence always has a few items close at hand. The fence Interacts to draw a weapon or item that takes a single action to activate, and then Strikes with the weapon or Activates the Item.

traits.name: Scoundrel's Feint
traits.text: When the fence successfully Feints, their target is flat-footed against the fence's attacks until the end of the fence's next turn. On a critical success, the target is flat-footed against all attacks until the end of the fence's next turn.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.text: The fence deals an extra 2d6 (2d6) precision damage to flat-footed creatures.
